summary: The full-size Ankh model; 1.15B-parameter T5 with 1536-dim embeddings that reached general-purpose state of the art with far fewer parameters than contemporaries.
architecture: T5 encoder–decoder with relative position bias (larger embedding dim, more attention heads and feed-forward layers than Ankh-base); 1536-dim per-residue encoder embeddings.
pretraining_objective: T5-style masked-span denoising (1-gram masking ~20%, full reconstruction).
key_innovations: State-of-the-art general-purpose PLM performance at <10% of prior training params
when_to_use: A strong, efficient alternative to ProtT5/ESM-2 for enzyme property prediction; 1536-dim embeddings balance quality and cost.
caveats: Encoder–decoder checkpoint carries unused decoder weights for embedding use; single-sequence, sequence-only.

citations.title: Ankh: Optimized Protein Language Model Unlocks General-Purpose Modelling
